O/o THE SUPERINTENDING ENGINEER, APMSIDC CIRCLE, KURNOOL
CDS Building, DM & HO Campus, Beside Red Cross, Kurnool District.
Memo. No. SE/APMSIDC/Knl,Cir/New GMC/ 2024-25/ Date: 09.2024
Sub:- SE, APMSIDC Circle, Kurnool – Establishment of New Govt Medical
Colleges at Adoni and Penukonda stopping of works at safe stage -
Instructions- Issued - Regarding
Ref:- 1) Instructions of Chief Engineer, APMSIDC Mangalagiri, Date: 30-08-
2024
०००
The immediate attention of the Executive Engineers reference MC
Divisions Adoni and Penukonda is invited to the Reference cited, where in
the Chief Engineer APMSIDC Mangalagiri has instructed to stop all the
works pertaining to Government Medical Colleges at Adoni and Penukonda
at safe stage as directed by the Government.
Therefore, the Executive Engineers concerned are here by, instructed
to stop all the works in Medical College premises immediately without
proceeding for further works But, the buildings for which casting of roof slab
is pending for want of completion of steel fabrication work that activity
casting of roof slab shall be completed soon after completion of steel
fabrication in order to leave the item at safe stage.
Further, the Executive Engineers Adoni and Penukonda are here by
directed to submit the Estimates for providing "Anti Corrosion Painting" for
the left over column reinforcement to prevent rusting. If the reinforcement of
the columns is less than 1.20m height, then dumy columns shall be
provided.

*P.R.Raddy 3-9-24*
Superintending Engineer,
APMSIDC Circle, Kurnool.
To
The Executive Engineer APMSIDC MC Division, Adoni.
The Executive Engineer APMSIDC MC Division, Penukonda.
Copy to the Chief Engineer, APMSIDC, Mangalagiri for favour of information
